AllowedDomains.title: Allowed email domains
AllowedDomains.description: Email domains whose accounts may sign in to covered AI services. Prefix with *. to also allow subdomains (e.g. *.example.org). An empty list blocks every sign-in.

OrganizationName.title: Organization name
OrganizationName.description: Shown to users on block messages.

SsoPortalUrl.title: Company sign-in portal URL
SsoPortalUrl.description: http(s) URL of your SSO portal (e.g. https://myapps.microsoft.com). Shown as a 'Go to company sign-in' button when something is blocked.

SupportMessage.title: Support message
SupportMessage.description: Extra text shown on block messages, such as how to contact IT.

AllowGoogleSignIn.title: Allow Sign in with Google
AllowGoogleSignIn.description: Allow 'Sign in with Google' for Google Workspace accounts in AllowedDomains. Personal Google accounts are refused by Google via the X-GoogApps-Allowed-Domains header.

AllowMicrosoftSignIn.title: Allow Sign in with Microsoft
AllowMicrosoftSignIn.description: Allow 'Sign in with Microsoft' for your Entra tenant only (Microsoft tenant restrictions). Requires MicrosoftTenantId. Personal Microsoft accounts are always blocked.

MicrosoftTenantId.title: Microsoft tenant ID
MicrosoftTenantId.description: Your Entra directory (tenant) ID. Required for AllowMicrosoftSignIn.

TenantRestrictionScope.title: Tenant restriction scope
TenantRestrictionScope.description: 'ai-sites' applies Google/Microsoft account restrictions only to sign-ins started from covered AI services. 'all-browsing' applies them to every Google/Microsoft sign-in in the browser.

ProviderModes.title: Per-service mode
ProviderModes.description: Override the mode for individual services by id (chatgpt, claude, gemini, copilot, perplexity, deepseek, grok, mistral, poe, meta). 'enforce' = work accounts only, 'block' = block the service, 'off' = do not manage.

SignOutOnInstall.title: Sign out of AI services on install
SignOutOnInstall.description: When the extension is first installed, clear cookies and site data for covered AI services so existing personal sessions end.
